purpose: Buff reference for AOBuddy10 Engineer decision-making: self-buffs to keep up, the very large set of buffs/auras the Engineer hands to OTHER players (its signature role), buffs to request from other professions, and general/consumable buffs. Pet buffs are deliberately NOT here - they live in engineer-pets.json.

dataSources.selfAndGivesIds: AOBuddy/GameData/profiles/engineer-nanos.json (nanos.ocp OMNICELL-CONTENT pack, client 18.8.50_EP1, 288 Engineer-castable nanos). Every id/name/number marked source=local came from that file.
dataSources.childNanoEffects: Aura/team/absorber parents only carry TeamCastNano / AreaCastNano / ChangeVariable. The REAL effects were read out of nanos.ocp with the extractor's diagnostic mode: dotnet run -c Release --project tools/mp-nano-extractor -- "E:\Funcom\OmniCell\OmniCell\Datafiles\nanos.ocp" <outdir> "<ids>" which prints strain, cast action requirements and every Event function with FunctionType/Target/ticks/args.
dataSources.statIdResolution: E:\Funcom\AOBuddy10\AOSharp.Common\GameData\Stat.cs (decimal arg -> hex enum). Key ones used here: 90-97 = Projectile/Melee/Energy/Chemical/Radiation/Cold/Poison/FireAC; 205-208,216,217,219,225 = Reflect*AC; 226-234 = Shield*AC (damage shield); 276 = AddAllOff; 277 = AddAllDef; 278-282,311,316,317 = the eight *DamageModifier stats; 360 = Scale; 156 = RunSpeed; 168 = NanoResist; 475-483 = MaxReflected*Dmg; 516 = AttackShield; 517 = SpecialAttackShield.
dataSources.functionTypeResolution: E:\Funcom\OmniCell\OmniCell\Libraries\Source\OmniCell.Enums\FunctionType.cs. 53045 Modify, 53012 Skill, 53110 ChangeVariable, 53066 TeamCastNano, 53087 AreaCastNano, 53117 TauntNpc, 53162 ResistNanoStrain, 53002 Hit, 53060 MonsterShape, 53184 ModifyPercentage, 53227 AddOffProc, 53236 RemoveNanoStrain, 53154 SummonPlayer, 53155 SummonTeamMates, 53240 = 'Undefined' in that enum (single nano-id argument; the named child nano carries the real effect).
dataSources.selfVsOtherTargeting: Read from each effect function's Target field: Target(3) = applied to the cast target (so the nano can be put on another character), User(1)/Wearer(2) = self only. This is the local-data basis for the selfBuffs vs givesToOthers split.
dataSources.crossProfAndGeneral: ao-universe.com Buffing Guide + Engineer Guide MKIII, wiki.aodb.us Who_Buffs_What and Engineer:Tips_and_Tricks. Other professions' nano ids are NOT in the Engineer extraction, so those ids are null and marked source=web.

coverage.excludedByDesign: 137 of 288 - Pets - Robot (90), Pets - Towers / Deployables (1), Pet Heals / Repair (10), Pet Buffs / Pet Utility (36). Those belong to engineer-pets.json.
coverage.note: Every one of the 151 in-scope nanos appears in exactly one of: selfBuffs, givesToOthers, hostileAurasAndDebuffs, travelAndUtility, deferredToPetsFile, notEngineerCastable, noOpOrEventNanos.

selfBuffs.name: Plasma Shield
selfBuffs.effect: All eight Shield*AC +65 (damage shield: attackers take 65 back) AND EnergyAC +1200.

Each member of the line also gives a big bonus to ONE armor class - Melee for the 'Spikes' names, Energy for the 'Electrical/Plasma/Cocoon/Array' names, Radiation for the 'Retaliatory Barrier' names - so pick by the AC you want as well as by shield value. 13 tiers, one nanoline (1): only one applies. source=local

selfBuffs.name: Fortress of Spikes
selfBuffs.note: Melee-AC variant of the top damage shield (MC/MM 815); use instead of Plasma Shield when melee AC matters more than energy AC. source=local

selfBuffs.name: Reactive Harmonic Cocoon
selfBuffs.effect: All eight Reflect*AC +29 and all eight MaxReflected*Dmg +40.
selfBuffs.note: Best RK reflect self/other buff (ST/MC 823). RK ONLY - the cast action carries ExpansionPlayfield==0, so it cannot be cast in Shadowlands; use the Empowered line there. 6 tiers share nanoline 2 and the Empowered line's children are ALSO nanoline 2, so they collide. source=local

selfBuffs.name: Empowered Pre-Nullity Cocoon

wantedFromOthers.buff: Wrangle (Trader, single: Weak -> Superb) / Team Skill Wrangler
wantedFromOthers.effect: Raises nearly two dozen weapon skills AND all nano skills at once; the single-target ladder in the AO-Universe Buffing Guide runs from 'Weak' (+3, 3 NCU) up to 'Superb' (+112), with team/premium versions similar. 'It is short in duration (3 minutes) and debuffs the trader casting it for the same duration.'
wantedFromOthers.note: THE #1 buff an Engineer asks for, and for two distinct reasons: (a) the nano-skill half (MaterialCreation / SpaceTime / MaterialMetamorphosis) lets the Engineer land a robot, aura or armor buff above its normal ceiling - the pet stays after the wrangle drops; (b) the weapon-skill half lets it over-equip its ranged weapon. Every Engineer nano in this file is gated on MC/ST/MM (e.g. Gift of Assurance needs MC 1839 / MM 1844), so one wrangle can move several tiers. source=web (ao-universe Buffing Guide; ao-universe Engineer Guide MKIII lists 'Team Skill Wrangler (Premium) - Adds nano skills and weapon skills' under Trader Buffs)

wantedFromOthers.effect: +40 / +80 / +125 to a single trade skill, no level limit.
wantedFromOthers.note: Engineers are the game's tradeskill class; these stack on top of the Engineer's own Knowledge/Mastery nanos for building bot trimmers, implants and Nano Programming work. source=web (ao-universe Engineer Guide MKIII, Trader Buffs section)

givesToOthers.name: Damage shield line (Spikes / Electrical / Barrier / Cocoon / Plasma)  [id 29774 = Plasma Shield]
givesToOthers.effect: All eight Shield*AC +N (the target returns N damage to melee attackers) PLUS a large bonus to one specific AC.
givesToOthers.wantedBy: Tanks and anything being hit in melee; also anyone who wants the extra single-AC chunk (Melee / Energy / Radiation).
givesToOthers.stackingTrap: 13 tiers, one nanoline (1). Also note the Engineer's Sympathetic damage-shield AURA children (154539/154540/154541) carry a cast requirement that the recipient already has Shield*AC > 0 - the aura BOOSTS an existing damage shield rather than granting one, so give the target one of these first.

givesToOthers.name: Harmonic Cocoon reflect line (Rubi-Ka)  [id 70295 = Reactive Harmonic Cocoon]
givesToOthers.effect: All eight Reflect*AC +N and all eight MaxReflected*Dmg +M on the cast target.
givesToOthers.wantedBy: Tanks and anyone stacking reflect; combines with Soldier reflect shields because the MaxReflected component raises the CAP on what a reflect returns.
givesToOthers.stackingTrap: RK ONLY - every tier's cast action carries ExpansionPlayfield==0. In Shadowlands use the Empowered line. Both lines' EFFECTS sit in nanoline 2, so they replace each other on the recipient.

givesToOthers.name: Empowered Harmonic Cocoon line (team reflect, Shadowlands)  [id 273341 = Empowered Pre-Nullity Cocoon]
givesToOthers.effect: TeamCastNano of a child nano onto every team member (ticks 120 x 12000 ms plus 240 x 6000 ms = ~24 minutes of re-application). The child gives Reflect*AC +N and MaxReflected*Dmg +M and carries its own Level requirement on the recipient.
givesToOthers.wantedBy: The whole team - the Shadowlands replacement for the RK Harmonic Cocoon line and the only way to reflect-buff six people with one cast.
givesToOthers.stackingTrap: Children are nanoline 2, so they overwrite a self/other-cast Harmonic Cocoon. Note the top RK tier (70295, +29/+40) has MORE Reflect AC than every Empowered tier except Pre-Nullity.

givesToOthers.name: Damage buff line (Gun Enhancement -> Entropy Weapon)  [id 29760 = Entropy Weapon]
givesToOthers.effect: Adds flat damage to every hit via the *DamageModifier stats (ignores the target's AC).
givesToOthers.wantedBy: Every damage dealer without a better same-line buff.
givesToOthers.stackingTrap: One nanoline (4). Boosted Tendons (269463) is in this line but targets Wearer - SELF ONLY, cannot be given away.

tiers.name: Boosted Tendons
tiers.effect: all eight *DamageModifier +35 and RangedInit +205 - SELF ONLY (targets Wearer)

givesToOthers.name: Ranged initiative line (Swift / Quick / Rapid Weapon)  [id 29779 = Rapid Weapon]
givesToOthers.wantedBy: Any ranged profession (Soldier, Agent, Fixer, Crat, Trader, other Engineers). Ranged init only - there is no melee-init version in the Engineer list.

givesToOthers.name: Sympathetic aura line (team aura - only ONE can run at a time)  [id 154550 = Sympathetic Reactive Cocoon]
givesToOthers.effect: A persistent TEAM aura: the parent runs TeamCastNano(child) for 720 ticks at 2000 ms (~24 minutes), re-applying the child to every team member every 2 seconds. The PARENT's own effect list is only the TeamCastNano - the child nano carries the real stats.
givesToOthers.wantedBy: The whole team. The Engineer's most distinctive group contribution. wiki.aodb.us Engineer:Tips_and_Tricks: Sympathetic Arms Enhancement 'is a completely separate Nanoline to the other professions' damage buffs and stacks up onto an already impressive array of damage added that effectively ignores AC'; Sympathetic Reactive Cocoon 'can be combined with soldier reflect shields to significantly increase damage returned to attackers'.
givesToOthers.stackingTrap: All 15 parents share strain 227 -> only ONE aura at a time; choose armour OR damage OR damage-shield OR reflect. The CHILDREN are in four DIFFERENT strains (228 armour, 229 damage, 230 damage shield, 231 reflect), which is why the aura stacks with other professions' equivalents. wiki.aodb.us: 'The Sympathetic line is not available in shops.' The auras also count as buffs for PvP-flag spreading (Engineer:Tips_and_Tricks).

givesToOthers.name: Sloughing / Isochronal special-attack absorber line  [id 273343 = Improved Isochronal Sloughing Combat Field]
givesToOthers.effect: Sets Stat 517 SpecialAttackShield = N (and on the two best, Stat 516 AttackShield = 1). N = the number of incoming SPECIAL attacks (Burst / Full Auto / Aimed Shot / Fling / Brawl / etc.) absorbed outright; AttackShield absorbs one normal attack. Self versions use ChangeVariable directly and refresh on a tick (223311 = 480 ticks x 3000 ms, ~24 min, topping the counter back to 9 every 3 s). The '...Field' versions TeamCastNano a child that sets 517 on every team member.
givesToOthers.wantedBy: The whole team in PvP and against special-attack-heavy mobs. Nobody else in the game hands out special-attack absorption.
givesToOthers.stackingTrap: Parents and children are strain 286 (except the two 768 parents), so a team member cannot hold both the Engineer's team field and a self absorber.

selfKeepUpOrder: 1. Armor: Gift of Assurance 227680 at L220 (else the best Assurance tier, else Aegis Barrier 29789) - nanoline 3, one only.

2. Aura: ONE Sympathetic aura (strain 227). Default Sympathetic Fortress Screen 154562 (all ACs +627) for survivability, or Sympathetic Entropy Infusion 154560 (all damage +25) when the team is DPS-limited.
3. Damage shield: Plasma Shield 29774 (nanoline 1) - and note the Sympathetic damage-shield aura children only land on someone who already has one.
4. Reflect: Empowered Pre-Nullity Cocoon 273341 in Shadowlands (team-wide), Reactive Harmonic Cocoon 70295 on Rubi-Ka (nanoline 2 either way).
5. Damage: Boosted Tendons 269463 on self (also +205 RangedInit); Entropy Weapon 29760 for everyone else (nanoline 4).
7. Special-attack absorber: Isochronal Sloughing Assault Shield 223311 on self (9 specials + 1 attack), or Improved Isochronal Sloughing Combat Field 273343 for the team.

8. Tradeskills when building: Engineer Composite Specialist Tradeskills 273346 (+200 x6, self) PLUS FQP/ME/Pharma/WS Mastery 227665/227667/227669/227671 - but NOT Electrical Engineering Knowledge/Mastery (same line 172 as the composite).
9. Weapon skills: Extreme Prejudice 29762 + Pistol Mastery 29246 (different lines, they stack).
nanolineStackingTraps: ArmorBuff(3): all 32 RK tiers AND the 4 SL Assurance tiers are one line - a single occupant.

EngineerAuras(227): all 15 Sympathetic parents share the strain -> ONE aura at a time (armour OR damage OR damage shield OR reflect). Their CHILDREN sit in four different strains (228/229/230/231), which is why the aura stacks with other professions' buffs of the same type.
EngineerDebuffAuras(236): all 14 Disruptive parents share the strain -> one hostile aura at a time, and running one means not running a Sympathetic aura.

ElectricalEngineeringBuff(172): Engineer Composite Specialist Tradeskills 273346 (+200 all six) sits in this line and therefore CANNOT coexist with Electrical Engineering Knowledge 227652 / Mastery 227663. It DOES stack with lines 173/174/175/176.
ReflectShield(2): the RK Harmonic Cocoon tiers AND the children of the SL Empowered line both live here - a recipient holds one.
DamageBuffs_LineA(4): Gun Enhancement / Energy Spike / Controlled Energy Overload / Entropy Weapon / Boosted Tendons - one only; Boosted Tendons is self-only.
EngineerSpecialAttackAbsorber(286): the self ChangeVariable versions and the team-cast children are all strain 286 - a team member cannot hold both the Engineer's team field and a self absorber.
PistolBuff(199) and GrenadeBuffs(207) are DIFFERENT lines: Pistol Mastery +40 and Extreme Prejudice +120 Pistol stack for +160 Pistol.
Chemistry_PharmBuff(196) vs PharmaceuticalsBuff(175) are different lines - Philosopher's Stone +62 stacks with Pharmaceuticals Mastery +125.
Breaking_Entry_DisarmTrapsBuff(206) vs DisarmTrapBuff(235) are different lines - Crowbar Subtlety and Trap Artifice stack.
twinkPriorityForEngineer: Trader Wrangle is the single biggest enabler: it raises MaterialCreation / SpaceTime / MaterialMetamorphosis (every Engineer nano is gated on those) AND the weapon skills, so one wrangle both lands a higher bot and over-equips the weapon.
Meta-Physicist Composite Mochams (+140 all nano skills) is the durable version of the same thing and is exactly what the AO-Universe Engineer Guide MKIII names for casting a bigger bot.
The Engineer's own tradeskill buffs (composite +200, or the five Mastery lines) plus a Trader trade-skill wrangle cover implant building and trimmer construction.
Attribute buffs for gear requirements: Enforcer Prodigious Strength / Essence of Behemoth (Str/Sta), Agent Feline Grace (Agi) / Enhanced Senses (Sense), Composite Attribute Boost (+12 all).
whereEngineerDiffersFromTheMpTemplate: The MP's give-away story is ONE thing (nano skills). The Engineer's is many: AC, damage shield, reflect, flat damage, ranged init, five trade skills, pistol/grenade, special-attack absorption, team teleport and a persistent team aura - so givesToOthers is by far the biggest section of this file.
The Engineer has essentially NO self nano-skill buff; it depends on the MP and the Trader for that. That is the exact mirror image of the MP's position.
givesToOthers here is a nano-by-nano ladder at every level (36 armour tiers, 13 damage shields, 15 auras, 10 tradeskill nanos), not a handful of top-tier nanos.
The Engineer has an AURA system (one at a time, 24-minute re-application) that the MP has nothing equivalent to, and a hostile aura branch that is a combat decision, not a buff decision.
The Engineer has no self-heal (Master's Repairs is a pet repair), so outside HP/heals matter more than for an MP.

The MP file's 'False Profession' puzzle is resolved here with hard evidence: those nanos require Profession==5 and are AGENT self-buffs that only appear in a profession extraction because of their VisualProfession clause.

_unverified: TauntNpc (FunctionType 53117) appears on the nine damage-shield/reflect Disruptive aura children with values 75-315. The function NAME comes from OmniCell's FunctionType enum; what a taunt component means on a HOSTILE area aura (who is taunted and by how much) is NOT established from the data. Reported as the raw function - do not build bot logic on an interpretation of it.

FunctionType 53240 is literally named 'Undefined' in OmniCell's enum. Every 'parent -> child nano' relationship marked with it here (the Sympathetic auras' second function pair, the Empowered cocoons, Coherent Polarized Screening, Shield of the Obedient Servant, Master's Repairs) is inferred from the argument being a nano id whose name matches the parent. Exact targeting semantics unconfirmed.

Shield of the Obedient Servant 202260 / Improved 270790: unresolved whether they buff the Engineer or the pet. No NPCFamily/MonsterData gate (unlike the confirmed pet nanos), but the name argues for the pet. Left in selfBuffs with a flag; do not auto-cast.
Master's Repairs 270351: child 301858's only function is Hit[27,10,0,0]. The AttackType/argument layout for FunctionType 53002 was not decoded, so the heal AMOUNT is unknown.

Technical Incompetence 266307 and Unsteady Hands 266309 each list TWO different Profession EqualTo values in their flattened cast-requirement list (5+3 and 3+4). The extractor flattens the requirement TREE, so an OR-branch cannot be distinguished from an AND - whether an Engineer can actually cast these is unresolved.

Isochronal Sloughing Combat Field 237273 (L212, Spec bit8) team-casts a child that sets SpecialAttackShield = 2, LOWER than the cheaper Sloughing Combat Field 204422 (=3). Read directly from nanos.ocp; the reason (its child additionally requires Shadowlands) is not established.

Extreme Prejudice 29762: local data gives Grenade +120, Pistol +120, HeavyWeapons +50. The AO-Universe Buffing Guide lists only '+50 Heavy Weapons' and '+120 Pistol'. Local data is treated as authoritative; the discrepancy is unexplained.

AO-Universe's Buffing Guide lists 'Composite Heavy Artillery' (+100 Grenade / HeavyWeapons / MG-SMG / RangedEnergy / Rifle) under Engineer. Local data contradicts it: nano 269482 'Composite Heavy Artillery' requires Profession==1 (SOLDIER) and is not in the 288-nano Engineer extraction. It is NOT an Engineer buff.

Nanos whose effect functions target 'Target' are recorded here as castable on others. That is the local-data signal; it does not by itself prove the client allows a friendly target for every one of them (e.g. the shared Pistol Mastery). Confirmed by web source for Pistol Mastery, Extreme Prejudice, Philosopher's Stone and Crowbar Subtlety only.
Aura/absorber DURATIONS are given as ticks x interval from the pack (720 x 2000 ms = ~24 min). Whether the client displays that as the buff duration was not cross-checked.

Cross-profession buff ids in wantedFromOthers are null - they are other professions' nanos and not in the Engineer extraction. Doctor nano-init name/value, Keeper aura names, Composite Attribute Boost id, and the general/city/tower buff sets are not pinned to a single source.

NCU costs are not in this file - the pack's nano records were read for effects and cast requirements only. AO-Universe supplies three (Extreme Prejudice 43 NCU, Philosopher's Stone 17 NCU, Crowbar Subtlety 7 NCU).
